title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERADIS - UnlimitedValidityConstraint
description: Unlimited validity constraint (era:UnlimitedValidityConstraint's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A validity constraint signalling that the CLD has no expiry — no end date or duration should be specified.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'UnlimitedValidityConstraint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
